text:
Sam (Growth): Quick triage: webinar landing + three post series. Main asks: keyword priorities, canonical policy, JSON-LD for event + FAQ, internal anchor matrix, and safe redirects for legacy /events and /webinars paths. Freeze by EOD.
Priya (SEO): I'll do a tight keyword map: primary + two supporting longtails per piece, plus SERP intent. Also will check title collisions with existing docs.
Noah (Content): Drafts uploaded. Adding 160-char metas and OG images (1200x630). Thinking FAQ markup only on recap and a short FAQ on landing.
Rafa (Web): For canonicalization we need rules: keep unique canonicals for evergreen posts; mass-301 only for true duplicates/splash pages. Also recommend using JSON-LD (not microdata) for portability. For client-side rendered pages we should pre-render the snippet. Example event JSON-LD to inject in head:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs at Scale","startDate":"2026-09-21T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-llms"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Priya (SEO): Also suggest SpeakerEvent extension if we want richer results with speaker names/social links. For recap post we'll add FAQPage markup — short Q/A pairs only.
Sam (Growth): Redirect strategy: avoid chains. We have /events/serve-llms-2024 -> staging -> /webinar/serve-llms. Want single 301 to canonical landing preserving UTM params. Rafa can implement whitelist rules.
Rafa (Web): I'll implement nginx `return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/serve-llms?$query_string;` for vetted slugs and run a dry-run via staging crawl. Will also ensure rel=canonical tags are present and meta robots not set to noindex.
Noah (Content): Internal linking plan suggestions: landing -> product pages (anchor variants: "LLM inference platform", "inference at scale", "reduce token cost"), benchmark -> /benchmarks ("inference benchmarks", "latency & cost charts"), recap -> /resources/webinars ("watch on-demand", "webinar recording"). I'll list three anchor variants per target in the sheet.
seo-bot: Preflight checks queued: unique title tags, unique meta descriptions, single H1, JSON-LD present for event/faq, internal links have descriptive anchor text, redirects are 301 and chain-free, sitemap updated and pinged.
Priya (SEO): Small ask: please avoid duplicating meta descriptions across landing & post A. If copy overlaps, tweak postA meta to focus on benchmark angle.
Sam (Growth): Owners & deadlines: Noah - final copy + metas + 3 slugs marked keep/301 (EOD); Priya - keyword map + anchor text (EOD); Rafa - redirect whitelist + JSON-LD placement + sitemap entries (tomorrow AM); seo-bot - run final scan after staging deploy.
Rafa (Web): Also will queue CDN invalidation for OG images and set sitemap entries: priority 0.8, weekly changefreq on publish.
Noah (Content): One question: do we want rel=next/prev on multi-page recap assets? Probably not needed here. I'll keep pages simple.
Sam (Growth): Cool. If anyone spots legacy AMP variants, flag them — they must canonicalize to main. Ping me for blockers before content freeze. Thanks!
